title: PixelPulse
tagline: Uniting NFT worlds, one community at a time.
description:
In today's world, multiple DAOs and NFT communities use Discord to socialize and conduct their governance. Discord being managed centrally, has the ability to shut off and disconnect these users. There are multiple fake communities created in the name of the original ones and lure the members into joining them. We present to you PixelPulse. A world for the NFT holders to socialize, be truly part of their community. NFT holders can join their community, chat with other NFT holders and be able to communicate with them via audio/video. It also gives holders to discover new NFT communities and jooin them to learn and grow. Our motto is One original community for particular DAO/NFT community.

how_its_made: We ran into issues while integrating Huddle01. The docs were not very clear on FAQs and some of the implementations. The team was really helpful in getting things cleared for us.
